items.title: At least 610 people are killed and 1,300 others are injured when a Mw 6.0 earthquake strikes Jalalabad, Nangarhar province, Afghanistan.
Over 1,000 people are killed when a landslide destroys a village in the Marrah Mountains area of western Sudan.
Hurricane Lester (2016) peaked at Category 4, 125-knot winds and 944 hPa
M 7.6 - 89 km E of Sulangan, Philippines
Hurricane Jimena (2009) peaked at Category 4, 135-knot winds and 931 hPa, making landfall 4 times
Iraq: Up to 1,000 people die in a stampede on the Al-Aaimmah bridge after rumours of a suicide bomber cause panic amongst pilgrims on the shrine of the Imam Musa al-Kazim.
Hurricane Becky (1974) peaked at Category 4, 115-knot winds and 977 hPa
M 7.1 - 35 km SE of Gonābād, Iran
M 7.2 - 149 km WNW of Iñapari, Peru
Hurricane 08 of 1933 (1933) peaked at Category 5, 140-knot winds and 940 hPa, making landfall once
M 7.1 - 5 km SE of Castilla La Nueva, Colombia
